text_block_list.text:
On the day of the tailoring contest hosted 
by Satono Crown's father's company— After 
taking a breather together, we head to the 
venue.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, the opening ceremony is finally 
starting!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"First up is a fashion show featuring 
Earth-san's live musical performance!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"O amori gathered here! Please receive 
this melody, born from today's 
one-and-only encounter between fashion and 
the violin!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The models' delicate expressions, combined 
with Earth-san's live accompaniment 
reacting to them! The realism was simply 
breathtaking, wasn't it!
choice_data_list:
I could really feel the raw power 
firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. All that planning for the staging 
really paid off! The atmosphere in the 
venue is perfect, and we've gotten off to 
a fantastic start!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's tour the tournament! Shall we 
start with the craftsmen's competition?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They compete in measuring and tailoring 
skills. You'll be amazed by their speed 
and precision♪

Escorted by Satono Crown, we head off to 
watch a dazzling display of craftsmanship.

text_block_list.name: Artisan A
text_block_list.text:
First, the measurements... Hah! Back 
length 72.6, shoulder width 45.3, sleeve 
length 54.2!

text_block_list.name: Artisan B
text_block_list.text:
"...Pattern paper, check. Let's start 
cutting it out. Deep breath in~~~~... and 
out!"
(Schiiing!)
choice_data_list: S-Such incredible efficiency...!?
S-Such incredible efficiency...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're totally captivated, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Getting to watch such elegant yet powerful 
craft up close... that's the real thrill 
of a tailor competition!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's about time. I'm curious to see 
everyone's reaction, but—
choice_data_list: What's starting next?
What's starting next?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You remember that app proposal we worked 
on with the other trainers before? It's 
time for the presentation♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's go get a closer look at the fruits 
of our hard work!

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. This app allows us to have design 
meetings even with clients on the other 
side of the globe! What do you think?
(Clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us show you just how convenient 
it really is. Everyone, please step right 
up to the demo booth!

The app was met with great interest, 
forming long lines at the trial booth.

And so, the tailoring tournament also 
concluded with immense success.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, results just as expected... No, 
even better than expected!

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Crown. Thanks to you, the 
excitement was at an all-time high.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Papa...! Duoxie. I'm honored to be of 
service.

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your cooperation as 
well. The photos in the proposal were 
wonderful.
choice_data_list: Y-you're too kind...!

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
I need to make the rounds to greet 
everyone, so I'll take my leave here. 
Crown, I continue to expect great things 
from you.

As we were leaving the venue, Satono Crown 
called out saying she needed to talk, and 
we moved to the observation deck of the 
building where the venue was located.
choice_data_list: What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This success is something I never could 
have achieved on my own.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Let me thank you again. You were a real 
lifesaver, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: I'm glad I was able to help.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And so—as a token of my gratitude, I'd 
like to have a suit tailored for you, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Huh? You sure?
Huh? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Please, allow me to give this 
to you as a token of my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you have any specific design in 
mind? I'll be the one designing it, so 
just say the word!
choice_data_list:
I wish I could look as capable at work as 
you do.
I want that competent vibe you have.

I wonder if it's something that could 
become a trend?
I want you to make it however you like!
I want you to make it however you like!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you have any specific design in 
mind? I'll be the one designing it, so 
just say the word!
choice_data_list:
I wish I could look as capable at work as 
you do.
I want that competent vibe you have.

I wonder if it's something that could 
become a trend?
I want you to make it however you like!
I want you to make it however you like!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, aren't you sweet♪ ...Just like me, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then why not go matching? Though I'll add 
some personalized touches to the details.
choice_data_list:
Sounds good, maybe I'll take you up on 
that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao ya! Fufu, time to show what I'm made 
of♪

We happily headed home together, chatting 
with Satono Crown about musical 
arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trends, huh. I know I'll get the right 
answer if I ask Mom and Jie-jie, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, no way! This is MY way of thanking 
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of vibe are you aiming for? 
British style? Or Italian? I'll look up 
whatever trend you desire!

I headed home amidst lively chatter, 
bombarded by a barrage of questions from 
Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then I'll have to put extra effort 
into making it♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, back when I wrote the app 
proposal, I already had an image of a 
design that would suit you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For instance, how about something like 
this? Or maybe—

And so, with Satono Crown happily tossing 
out ideas the whole way, we made our 
journey home.
